attempts.raw: {"risk": 5, "reason": "Major version bump of Elastic.Clients.Elasticsearch (8→9) removes the 'language' analyzer support entirely and changes core API surface (GetMapping/GetIndex response shapes, DynamicTemplate construction), which will break any existing tenant indices/mappings using the language analyzer and likely requires Elasticsearch server 9.x compatibility, a breaking infrastructure requirement for hosted sites."}
